territory: SAM/PEFT: Segment Anything family adaptation, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/adapters/prompt tuning) for segmentation foundation models
schema_notes: Each JSONL line carries the parent-mandated fields (candidate_id, territory, one_line_idea, cluster, problem, core_hypothesis, falsifiable_prediction, why_important, why_possibly_novel, minimal_falsification_experiment, main_risk, community_default_belief, why_it_might_be_wrong, fastest_falsifying_experiment, evidence_label) plus title and the task_queue shard_format aliases (core_claim, method_sketch, novelty_hook, kill_risk) mirroring their counterparts. Every candidate answers: what the community assumes (community_default_belief), why it may be wrong (why_it_might_be_wrong), and the fastest falsifying experiment (fastest_falsifying_experiment).

compliance.forbid_fiction: No fabricated papers, citations, benchmark numbers, dataset facts, or claimed experimental results; all quantitative statements are phrased as falsifiable predictions under HYPOTHESIS or MODEL SPECULATION labels.
compliance.novelty_claims: All novelty statements are hedged as possibly-novel and explicitly marked unverified; no verified novelty claimed.
compliance.protected_files: window.lock.json, research_state.json, ideas_master.jsonl untouched; no Windows dirs created; no Windows numbers scanned.

unresolved_items: Novelty of all 110 candidates is unverified against the literature; Wave B dedup plus any novelty-checking stage must vet before promotion.

Intra-shard near-duplicates were minimized by design but a few conceptual neighbors remain for dedup review (e.g. samp-0006 vs samp-0102 on trivial-baseline audits; samp-0021 vs samp-0044 on drift metric vs retention benchmark; samp-0072 vs samp-0075 on routing vs retrieval; samp-0103 vs samp-0105 on prompt-protocol confounds).

Cross-territory overlap likely with genA-02 (medical seg), genA-08 (uncertainty), and genA-07 (benchmark weaknesses) shards; dedup should treat cluster tags uncertainty_calibration_quality and evaluation_benchmark_hygiene as high-collision zones.
